purpose: Generic Coupang shopping destination for editorially neutral site-wide CTAs

links.disclosure: 이 포스팅은 쿠팡 파트너스 활동의 일환으로, 이에 따른 일정액의 수수료를 제공받습니다.
notes: Use only as a general shopping link; do not describe it as a link to a specific product.
Insert only into published posts where a neutral shopping CTA is appropriate.
Deduplicate by link URL and stable marker.
Preserve post status, publication date, featured image, title, and existing content.
After each update, read the post back from WordPress REST API and verify the URL, disclosure, and marker.
